recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is for the current FHIR build. No further core source work is needed for FHIR-32309; any R4 technical-correction/backport request would be a separate release-management decision.
issue_request: FHIR-32309 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking the search _count narrative to replace invalid `entry.search.mode = search` wording with `entry.search.mode = match`.
initial_application: No git commit explicitly mentions FHIR-32309. The Jira comment says the change was already applied, and git history shows commit b1647bc02fa86a7e764b671c94f2fcd03755183b for FHIR-32017 made the exact source/search.html replacement and was merged through PR #1428.
additional_context: FHIR-32017 is the same-change-family published issue for the same sentence. The current Bundle.entry.search.mode code system defines `match`, `include`, and `outcome`, not `search`. Later source cleanup retained the corrected wording, a 2023 Zulip thread confirmed it was fixed in the R5 build, and Confluence searches found no conflicting references.
reconciliation: Published an empty audit commit. The current build-scope source/search.html _count section already says `_count` applies to resources with `entry.search.mode = match`, and the authoritative code system confirms that `match` is the valid code.
